effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] ＜Blitz＞ (If your opponent has 1 or more memory, this Digimon may attack.) [When Attacking] Delete up to 6000 DP total worth of your opponent's Digimon. [Your Turn] While you have [Kanata Hondo], this Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ and can also attack your opponent's unsuspended Digimon. (When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, it checks security before the attack ends.)
